summary.name: Youtube Music Desktop
summary.one_liner: An unofficial cross-platform desktop player for YouTube Music, built to run lighter than a Chrome tab.
use_cases: Play YouTube Music outside a browser tab
Control playback with keyboard media keys
Show current song on Discord profile
Bind custom hotkeys to player actions
summary.what_it_does: The app wraps YouTube Music in a standalone desktop window, described as lightweight and designed to avoid the RAM use of a Chrome tab. It supports keyboard media keys and the macOS Touch Bar so playback can be controlled without switching apps. It integrates Discord Rich Presence to show the currently playing track. A separate dedicated remote application lets you control playback from a smartphone. Users can bind any key to a chosen action for quick control from anywhere.
notable: Keyboard media keys and Touch Bar support
caveats: Unofficial app, not made by YouTube or Google
Platform list (iOS) refers to the remote app; the page does not explicitly list desktop platforms beyond 'cross platform'
